Name: Full Inventory View
Author: Cpdncristiano
Description:
[b]Full Inventory View[/b]

This mod improves the inventory interface in [i]Stardew Valley[/i] by making expanded inventories easier to view and manage.

By default, the game only displays up to three inventory rows. With this mod, the interface can dynamically show more rows when there is enough space, giving you a cleaner view of expanded backpacks without wasting space or breaking the layout.

For very large inventories, the mod uses a smart scrollbar instead of trying to display every slot at once. This keeps the inventory readable and usable even with massive backpack expansions.

[b]🚀 What's New in This Version:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Improved Expanded Inventory Layout:[/b] The inventory can now display more rows when there is enough space, while keeping the layout cleaner and more consistent.[/*]
[*][b]Smart Scrollbar Integration:[/b] Extremely large inventory expansions are handled with a dynamic scrollbar instead of forcing every slot onto the screen. Yes, even massive backpack mods with hundreds of slots are supported.[/*]
[*][b]Better Button Layout Handling:[/b] Side buttons are repositioned more carefully when the inventory grows, helping avoid overlap with expanded layouts.[/*]
[*][b]Improved Compatibility Handling:[/b] This version includes additional work to behave better with other mods that also modify inventories, chests, menu layouts, or interface buttons.[/*]
[*][b]Safer Patch Loading:[/b] If a compatibility patch cannot be applied, the game should continue loading normally. The mod will log the issue instead of crashing the game.[/*]
[*][b]Cleaner Logs:[/b] Debug logs have been reduced so player logs stay cleaner. The mod now tries to report only important information.[/*]
[/list]
[b]⚠️ Important:[/b]

This mod [b]does not increase[/b] inventory capacity on its own. It only updates the visual representation and layout to support expanded inventories.

To actually increase your inventory capacity, you still need to use a companion mod like [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21591]The Return Of More Backpack Upgrades[/url][/b] or another backpack expansion mod.

[b]🧩 Compatibility:[/b]

This mod is designed to work with expanded inventories and tries to cooperate with other mods that modify the game’s menus. However, many Stardew Valley mods modify the same inventory and chest interfaces, so small visual issues or layout conflicts may still happen depending on your mod setup.

If you find a bug, please send your SMAPI log and describe which mods were installed when the issue happened. This makes it much easier to identify compatibility problems.

[b]🤖 Transparency About AI Use:[/b]

I want to be transparent about how this mod is developed. Around [b]80% of the current codebase has been built, reviewed, or adjusted with the help of artificial intelligence[/b].

When I first created this mod, I was mainly trying to solve a problem in my own game. After I got it working, I decided to publish it so other players could use it too. At that time, I had limited knowledge of C#, so I relied on research, testing, trial and error, and online resources to build the first version.

Later, especially in recent updates, I needed to solve more complex compatibility issues with other mods and modified menu layouts. To help with that, I started using AI as a development assistant, mainly for analyzing code, suggesting fixes, refactoring older parts, and understanding conflicts between mods.

Even though a large part of the code has been generated or assisted by AI, I still test the mod, review the changes, make the final decisions, and continue adjusting it based on real gameplay issues and player feedback. The goal is to keep the mod useful, stable, and more compatible for players who use expanded inventories.
